title: 第19章 让师兄我来好好教你第20章 周师兄其人
slug: 系统绑错人龙套被迫走主角剧本
content_zh:
此刻的漱月峰大湖上的某座亭子内，龙涛和南宇辰正对坐在圆桌前，后者被对方说的有些不好意思，但还是不想说出那人的名字。
“龙师兄，不是我袒护那人，只是...那位师兄在内门弟子中名声很好，真要向师尊她们告状的话，会...会很麻烦的。”
龙涛此时本能地嗅到了破局的契机，这里如果能用话术引导成功的话，自己今晚就有可能留在漱月峰上了，于是他酝酿了一下说到，
“唉...我知你心善，不愿因私事搞风搞雨，那让师兄我来猜猜看，也不要多，就一次...如果我能一次就猜到那人是谁，你便点头认下，如何？”
南宇辰茫然地点点头，心里却笃定，自己从未透露过半字线索，龙师兄绝无可能猜中！
那人的伪装，连他这当事人若非铁证如山都不敢信，外人如何看破？
“唔...如果我没猜错的话，那人面貌儒雅，声音温和，是大家理想中的师兄模样，就是周师兄...没错吧。”
看着眼睛瞪得和铜铃一般大的南宇辰，龙涛心中大石落下，他知道自己猜对了，今晚任务的第一个难关也算是度过了。
“龙师兄！
你...你...你怎么知道的，我没和你说过啊！
连周师兄的长相也没和你提过一个字啊！”
“也是碰巧吧，今天我在灵泉苑帮工的时候，那个周师兄也在，我和他打过几个照面。”
他语气带着一丝讥讽，“怎么说呢...那种人、骗骗你这种小孩子没什么问题，但稍微有些阅历的，就能看出他是个伪君子。”
南宇辰不知该如何形容此刻的心情，眼前的师兄明明只是个练气五层，却仿佛散发着深不可测的光芒，将他护在身后！
“可...周师兄他...言谈举止真的毫无破绽啊！
，坦白说...要不是我查过那些任务记录，到现在都不会相信他是个坏人，他真的...就是个完美的师兄啊。”
“唉...所以说你是个傻小子啊，不过想要和你具体说道的话，不是三言两语能说清的，今天也不早了，我这外人也不好在漱月峰久留，就明天或者之后找时间和你讲讲吧。”
之后？！
这下可把南宇辰急坏了，自己最关心的真相就在眼前，结果突然要走人谁能忍，就如同故事听到最精彩处断了章一样！
“龙师兄！

别走！
直接留下也行，我作为师尊弟子，可以邀请你作为客人留宿的，我隔壁就有干净客房，你今晚就住下好了。”
成功了！
龙涛表面波澜不惊，内心却发出一声大喊，这次任务的第一步，留在漱月峰过夜达成，而且如他所料，果然还是得靠南宇辰作为破局点。
“这...那也行吧，只要不麻烦就好，不过我们毕竟要谈论其他同门，在外面多少有些不便，干脆就直接先回你的住处吧。”
南宇辰自是立即答应，带着龙涛便离开了这座湖中小岛。
从云路离开那座大湖后，龙涛再次回到了天幕之外，此时他才发现，太阳还未下山，回头望去，不仅天幕和假月亮消失，那座湖看着也变成了个普通水潭大小，倒映着真实的夕阳。
“这…这是？！”
“哦，刚才我们所在的‘揽月湖’，其实是一个小洞天。”
南宇辰随口解释了一下。
洞天！
龙涛这下又被吓到了，这玩意儿在修仙界，是足以成为中小宗门立派根基的重宝！
多少元婴老怪都求而不得！
明烛真人...一个金丹...竟然拿它当私家景观湖......
不过离开洞天后，漱月峰也恢复了浮空仙山应有的正常大小，而南宇辰的住处则位于一个风景秀丽的小山崖边，溪流、灵植、池塘、药圃、小楼，样样不缺，简直就是龙涛理想中的住所。
步入小楼，龙涛就发现不少他梦寐以求却不得的宝物，从服装饰品到兵器符箓，都随意摆放，只是他现在完全没心思关注这些，还在思考着今晚那必死的偷窥任务。
“对了，容我冒昧问一下，你师父那么关心你，会不会在你房间里装什么...那个...偷听的东西吧，比如侦听虫什么的。”
“怎么可能！”
南宇辰立刻摇头，语气斩钉截铁，“师尊亲口说过，居室乃修行人最后一方净土，隐私大过天！
content_en:
At this moment, in a pavilion on the Great Lake of Shuyue Peak, Long Tao and Nan Yuchen were sitting opposite each other at a round table. The latter was a little embarrassed by the other party's remarks, but still didn't want to say that person's name.
"Senior Brother Long, it's not that I'm protecting that person, it's just that... that senior brother has a very good reputation among the inner disciples. If he really wants to complain to Master and the others, it will be... very troublesome."
At this time, Long Tao instinctively sensed an opportunity to break the situation. If he could successfully use words to guide him here, he might stay on Shuyue Peak tonight, so he thought for a while and said,
"Sigh... I know you are kind-hearted and don't want to cause trouble for personal matters. Then let me guess, senior brother. It doesn't take too much, just once... If I can guess who the person is in just one try, you can nod and recognize him, how about it?"
Nan Yuchen nodded blankly, but he was sure in his heart that he had never revealed a clue, and there was no way Senior Brother Long could guess it!
Even the client would not believe the person's disguise unless there was irrefutable evidence. How could outsiders see through it?
"Well...if I guessed correctly, that man has an elegant face and a gentle voice. He is everyone's ideal senior brother. He is Senior Brother Zhou...that's right."
Looking at Nan Yuchen, whose eyes were as big as copper bells, Long Tao's heart dropped. He knew that he had guessed correctly, and he had passed the first difficulty of tonight's mission.
"Senior Brother Long!
You...you...how do you know? I never told you!
I haven’t even mentioned a word about Senior Brother Zhou’s appearance to you! "
"It's a coincidence. When I was helping at Lingquanyuan today, Senior Brother Zhou was also there. I met him several times."
There was a hint of sarcasm in his tone, "How should I put it... It's okay for that kind of person to lie to a kid like you, but anyone with a little experience can tell that he is a hypocrite."
Nan Yuchen didn't know how to describe his mood at this moment. The senior brother in front of him was obviously only a fifth-level Qi practitioner, but he seemed to be emitting unfathomable light, protecting him behind him!
"But...Senior Brother Zhou...his speech and behavior are really flawless!
, Frankly speaking...if I hadn't checked those mission records, I still wouldn't believe that he was a bad person. He is really...a perfect senior brother. "
"Sigh... So you are a stupid boy, but what I want to tell you in detail cannot be explained in a few words. It is also early today, and it is not easy for an outsider like me to stay in Shuyue Peak for a long time. I will find time to talk to you tomorrow or later."
After? !
This made Nan Yuchen extremely anxious. The truth he cared about most was right in front of his eyes. Who could bear it when he suddenly wanted to leave? It was like the best part of a story was cut off!
"Senior Brother Long!
Don't go!
You can just stay. As Master's disciple, I can invite you to stay as a guest. There is a clean guest room next door to me. You can stay here tonight. "
Success!
Long Tao was calm on the surface, but he shouted in his heart. The first step of this mission was to stay at Shuyue Peak overnight, and as he expected, Nan Yuchen still had to be relied upon as a breaking point.
"This...that's fine, as long as it's not a hassle. But after all, we have to talk about other classmates. It's a bit inconvenient to be outside, so we might as well go back to your residence first."
Nan Yuchen immediately agreed and left the island in the lake with Long Tao.
After leaving the big lake from Yunlu, Long Tao returned to the outside of the sky again. Only then did he realize that the sun had not yet set. Looking back, not only did the sky and the fake moon disappear, but the lake also became the size of an ordinary pool, reflecting the real sunset.
"This...this is?!"
"Oh, the 'Moon Lake' we were in just now is actually a small cave."
Nan Yuchen explained casually.
Cave!
Long Tao was frightened again. In the world of immortal cultivation, this thing is enough to become a small and medium-sized sect.An important treasure that is the foundation of the Li sect!
How many Yuanying old monsters can't get it!
Master Mingzhu... a golden elixir... actually uses it as a private landscape lake...
However, after leaving the cave, Shuyue Peak returned to its normal size as a floating fairy mountain, and Nan Yuchen's residence was located on the edge of a beautiful hill cliff. It had streams, spiritual plants, ponds, medicinal gardens, and small buildings. It was simply Long Tao's ideal residence.
Entering the small building, Long Tao found many treasures that he had dreamed of but could not find, ranging from clothing and accessories to weapons and talismans, all placed randomly. However, he had no intention of paying attention to them now, and was still thinking about the inevitable voyeuristic mission tonight.
"By the way, let me take the liberty to ask, if your master cares so much about you, would he put something...that...eavesdropping thing in your room, such as a listening bug or something."
"How is that possible!"
Nan Yuchen immediately shook his head and said with a firm tone, "Master said personally that the living room is the last pure land of a cultivator, and privacy is as great as the sky!
